name: Landmark Nominations Advisory Subcommittee Special Meeting Agenda (PDF)
agenda_text:
SPECIAL MEETING
  OF THE LANDMARK NOMINATIONS ADVISORY SUBCOMMITTEE
 C
  OF THE CULTURAL HERITAGE COMMISSION

  City of Beverly Hills
  Room 280B
  In-Person / Teleconference I Video Conference Meeting
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210

  Monday, October 2, 2023
  2:30 PM
Pursuant to Government Code Section 54953, members of the Landmark Nominations Advisory
Subcommittee of the Cultural Heritage Commission and staff may participate in this meeting via a
teleconference.  Members of the public can participate in the meeting by using this link:
www.beverlyhllls.org/subcommittee (passcode 90210) or by phone at 833-548-0276 (Meeting ID: 844 6491
8768). Written comments may be emailed to commentCHCCdbeverIyhllls.org and will be read at the
meeting.

  SPECIAL MEETING AGENDA

1. PUBLIC COMMENT

2. DISCUSSION OF POTENTIAL FUTURE NOMINEES FOR LANDMARK DESIGNATION

3. DISCUSSION OF GOLDEN  SHIELD CULTURAL RECOGNITION PROGRAM  FUTURE
  POTENTIAL DESIGNATIONS

4. CONSIDERATION FOR POTENTIAL  LISTING  FOR  MASTER  ARCHITECT-ELIGIBLE
  PROPERTIES WITHIN THE CITY

5. ADJOURNMENT

 Masa Alkire, AICP, City Planner

Posted: September 29, 2023

  Pursuant to the Americans with Disabilities Act, the City of Beverly Hills will make reasonable efforts to
  accommodate persons with disabilities. If you require special assistance, please call (310) 285-1126
  (voice) or (310) 285-6881 (TTY). Providing at least forty-eight (48) hours advance notice will help to
  ensure availability of services.
